name: multi-if-combinator
title: Multi-If Combinator
author: André Luiz Tosin
description: A combinator that evaluates many fully independent IF conditions at once, each with its own dedicated output (IF iron < 500 THEN output iron = 500). Solves the vanilla decider limitation where all conditions share a single combined output. Custom GUI for per-row mapping, UPS-friendly scripted output via a hidden constant combinator, blueprint and copy-paste support.
